title: Internationalization (i18n) Routing
description: Serve your app in multiple languages with built-in i18n routing and automatic locale detection.

slides.title: Going Global 🌍
Configuring i18n (next.config.js)
slides.content: Define your supported languages and the default one.

quizData.question: With i18n enabled, what URL will serve the French version of the /about page?
quizData.explanation: Next.js automatically prefixes routes with the locale, e.g., `/fr/about`.

slides.title: Accessing the Locale 🗣️
Locale Switcher (components/LanguageSwitcher.js)
slides.content: A dropdown to change language, navigating to the same page in the new locale.

quizData.question: How do you navigate to the same page but in a different locale?
quizData.explanation: Passing the `locale` option to `router.push` changes the locale while keeping the same page.

slides.title: Domain‑Based Localization 📌
Static Generation & i18n ✨
slides.content: For static generation, Next.js automatically builds all locale versions of each page. A page at `pages/about.js` will generate `/en/about`, `/fr/about`, etc., if locales are configured. You can use `getStaticProps` to load locale‑specific data.
